title: dactylis glomerata subsp. stebbinsii
intro: Dactylis glomerata subsp. stebbinsii, commonly known as Stebbins' bentgrass, is a subspecies of the Dactylis glomerata grass species. This plant is used in herbal medicine and has been traditionally employed for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Stebbins' bentgrass include reducing inflammation and promoting digestive health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
